delivery: Reviewed changes prepared for publication on PR #12. Commit and remote-check status are recorded separately in the supervisor handoff.

implementation.committedBlobLookups: One bounded NUL-framed cat-file batch replaces two rev-parse processes per file. HEAD queries use the captured commit ID.
implementation.workingBlobChecks: Git still hashes each exact captured byte buffer with its original path, preserving clean filters, attributes and line-ending normalization.
implementation.failureHandling: Malformed, missing, reordered or extra batch records fail closed. Hash-worker failures stop queued work and drain active children before rejection.
implementation.snapshotContract: File rows, inventory digest and every existing verification boundary are preserved; no cross-scan cache was introduced.

benchmark.scope: One offline snapshot before and after, using the identical clean checkout and historical 648-file inventory. These are local measurements, not end-to-end live-request times.
benchmark.method: benchmark.mjs intercepts the existing Git child-process launches, records counts/concurrency, and asserts every output file row and inventory hash against the frozen configuration. Git optional index writes and external access were disabled.

validation.focusedRunnerRegression: PASS after implementation, then PASS after the requested worker-drain and literal-filename test additions
validation.fullRegression: PASS: all 136 suites, including smoke coverage, in 157.55 seconds
validation.independentReview: NO_MATERIAL_FINDINGS; worker-drain test gap closed and independently reviewed

holds.historicalCapture: Preserved six-response partial capture remains non-canonical. No frozen configuration or stopped capture artifact was rewritten.
holds.futureLiveWork: Requires a fresh scope and newly reviewed/frozen configuration for the changed runner; do not resume the stopped namespace.
